_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen_fastpath_baseline.py, then edited by hand. Pre-existing divergences from the pinned jsonata-js, marked xfail(strict) by tests/python/test_fastpath_differential.py. Two owners. #111: the $sift predicate uses the flat is_truthy rule instead of $boolean, so $reverse/$zip-driven predicates keep keys jsonata-js drops. And the $formatNumber picture validator, which picks a different error code: jsonata-js runs every sub-picture check in sequence and lets the LAST failure win, while ours returns on the first, so a picture that fails both D3085 and D3086 is reported as D3085. Surfaced by the harness learning to compare error codes; a measured spread of malformed pictures shows the same selection difference in six more shapes. Shrink this list; do not grow it.
